Boxes: academic-pipeline: Step 3: the author writes the response letter, point by point (agent); Step 4: re-review, completeness, consistency, truthfulness, a verdict per point (agent); Verdicts; no reassessment of the paper, no new requests (agent) | paper, as built: Draft writer, fresh: response-letter.md beside the manuscript, in the response template's form [5.Q item 5] (ruled); Peer reviewer, fresh: completeness, consistency, truthfulness, a verdict per point, response-letter-check.md [5.Q item 5] (ruled); Verdicts in the final message; no manuscript file changed (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
